Explicit confirmation and permission controls for actions
Kafka or Redpanda for event streaming
Do not assume public API access grants commercial redistribution rights
CryptoX must not depend on a single data provider.
Use licensed APIs, official WebSockets, blockchain RPCs/indexers and proprietary infrastructure rather than unauthorized scraping or redistribution.
Treat market data, exchange execution, custody, accounting and compliance as separate high-risk systems.
Use immutable/double-entry accounting for financial balances.
Design for provider failures, data corruption, network outages and regional failures.
24/7/365 means fault-tolerant continuous operation with redundancy, failover, monitoring, backups and disaster recovery—not an absolute guarantee of zero downtime.
